in_sanskrit.name: Pargi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Daughter of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pargi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pargi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Par' meaning 'Supreme' and 'Gaur' meaning 'God'. It is a name given to a girl born in a divine or pious family, signifying her divine connection and heritage.
